g.text: SCHEMATIC: DUAL AC METERING & ACTUATION SUBSYSTEM
COMPANY: BS COMPUTER / ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING THESIS
DATE: 2026-10-17 | KiCad Eeschema v7/v8 Precision Master
1. NET LABELS: MATCHING LABELS SHARE THE SAME ELECTRICAL CONNECTION WITHOUT SPAGHETTI TRACES.
2. GALVANIC ISOLATION: 220V MAINS IS OPTO-ISOLATED VIA PS1, U2 (ZMPT101B), & RELAYS K1–K3 (OPTICAL ISOLATION).
3. SENSITIVITY CALIBRATION: ACS712-05B CURRENT SENSITIVITY CALIBRATED AT 185.0 mV/A (5A FULL SCALE).
4. RADAR & PIR: DUAL OCCUPANCY SENSORS (PIR ON GPIO 22, 24GHz MMWAVE RADAR ON GPIO 4).
5. SAFETY PROTECTION: F1 (5A 250V SLOW-BLOW) + MOV1 (10D471K 470V SURGE CLAMP).
